name: Brotherly Love
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Tragic... My brother faces me on the field of battle: A commander for the Stormpike.

Of the four Stormpike Commanders, he is undoubtedly the most dangerous. Perhaps if he is slain, the Banshee Queen could turn him as she did me - show him the error of his ways...

Deep within enemy territory you will find my brother. Slay him and return to me. I trust that you are capable of completing this mission, soldier.

And soldier, do not go alone.
narrative.objectives: Travel into Stormpike territory and slay Commander Karl Philips. Return to Commander Louis Philips when the task is complete.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Your heroics will not go unnoticed, adventurer.

I must waste no time if he is to be saved. Sylvanas must be contacted!
narrative.requestItemsText: How it must pain him to remain as one of the living while his beloved brother has ascended to perfection.
